overall_summary: Overall views are low across the board (ranging from 0 to 36), indicating early-stage channel distribution. However, 'self respect' and personal device-interaction hooks (like typing and deleting messages, or reviewing blocked/saved numbers) show slightly higher engagement relative to other abstract themes.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like AfaLxMy6FMY ('उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी') and aNR94Xxn0yM ('बिना नाम के सेव किया था नंबर') achieved higher views (36 and 24) compared to abstract poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on physical, everyday digital micro-actions related to smartphones and personal boundaries.

weak_patterns.evidence: hrjJ-QS9M8w ('इमरजेंसी कॉन्टैक्ट से उसका नंबर हटाते वक्त') got 0 views, indicating either poor initial distribution or an overly specific/niche scenario that didn't connect.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly clinical or rare scenarios; stick to universal everyday relationship micro-moments.

next_video.hook_style: Visual digital action combined with internal hesitation
